title: Bulacan Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Bulacan Marathon 2026 Review | SM Center Pulilan
meta_description: Bulacan Marathon 2026 review: about 5,500 runners at SM Center Pulilan on 9 August, run through rain and cold across the 42K, 21K, 10K and 5K.
dek: Bulacan's provincial marathon drew about 5,500 runners to SM Center Pulilan on 9 August 2026, in the rain. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Bulacan Marathon is a provincial race with a sizeable field. About 5,500 runners from across the province took part on 9 August 2026 at SM Center Pulilan, braving rain and cold [1]. It was organised by Team Malofit and Pairfect Fit [1]. The one report on the day describes the turnout and the weather, not the course or the organisation, so treat this as a solid local race rather than a destination event, and bring rain gear in August.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: Around 5,500 runners took part in the Bulacan Marathon on 9 August 2026, based at SM Center Pulilan [1]. It was organised by Team Malofit and Pairfect Fit, with the mall as the official venue [1].
The runners braved rain and cold on the day [1]. August is the rainy season in Central Luzon, and 2026 showed what that can mean on race morning.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you live in Bulacan or the north of Metro Manila and want a local marathon or half with a big field, yes.
Beyond turnout and weather, the published report says little: nothing on the course, water stations, timing or results. Check those details with the organisers before you enter, and plan for rain.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Bulacan Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Around 5,500 runners from across the province took part on 9 August 2026, at SM Center Pulilan in Bulacan. The race was organised by Team Malofit and Pairfect Fit and ran in rain and cold weather.

faqs.question: Where is the Bulacan Marathon held?
faqs.answer: At SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, which served as the official venue in 2026. The event offers the full marathon along with shorter races, and is aimed at runners from across the province and nearby Metro Manila.

faqs.question: What was the weather like at the 2026 Bulacan Marathon?
faqs.answer: Wet. The Daily Tribune reported that runners braved the rain and cold on 9 August 2026. August falls in the rainy season in Central Luzon, so prepare for rain if you enter a future edition.
